bkra shis rtags brgyad dang rin chen sna bdun gyi dbang bzhugs so/ /bde chen zhing sgrub kyi dbang gi lhan thabs tshe dbang rgyas pa nas khol du phyung ba ni

tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250bkra shis rtags brgyad dang rin chen sna bdun gyi dbang bzhugs so// 1$0000300

bde chen zhing sgrub kyi dbang gi lhan thabs tshe dbang rgyas pa nas khol du phyung ba ni/ hūm̐/ bkra shis gdugs kyis dbang bskur bas// slob ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis// chos kyi gdugs bskor nus pa yi// dbang dang ldan nas tshe 'phel shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ hūm̐/ bkra shis gser nyas dbang bskur bas// slob ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis// 'od kyis stong gsum khyab nus pa'i// dbang dang ldan nas tshe 'phel shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ hūm̐/ bkra shis dung gis dbang bskur bas// slob ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis// snyan grags stong gsum khyab nus pa'i// dbang dang ldan nas tshe 'phel shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ hūm̐/ bkra shis pad+mas dbang bskur bas// slob ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis// 'gro ba srid las bsgral nus pa'i// dbang dang ldan nas tshe 'phel shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ hūm̐/ bkra shis bum pas dbang bskur bas// slob ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis// chos kun khong du chud nus pa'i// dbang dang ldan nas tshe 'phel shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ hūm̐/ bkra shis dpal be'us dbang bskur bas// slob ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal skyob nus pa'i// dbang dang ldan nas tshe 'phel shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ hūm̐/ bkra shis 'khor los dbang bskur bas// slob ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nus pa'i// dbang dang ldan nas tshe 'phel shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ hūm̐/ bkra shis rgyal mtshan dbang bskur bas// slob ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis// tshe ni nub par mi 'gyur ba'i// dbang dang ldan nas tshe 'phel shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ ༈ hūm̐/ nor bu 'khor lo 'di nyid ni/

khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor byas te// tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ hūm̐/ nor bu rin chen 'di nyid ni/ khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis// bsam pa'i don kun 'grub 'gyur te// tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ hūm̐/ nor bu blon po 'di nyid ni/ khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis// snang srid dbang du 'dus gyur te// tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ hūm̐/ nor bu btsun mo 'di nyid ni/ khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis// dga' bzhi rgyud la skyes gyur te// tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ hūm̐/ nor bu glang po 'di nyid ni/ khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis// brtul zhugs che bar gyur nas kyang*// tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ hūm̐/ nor bu rta mchog 'di nyid ni/ khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis// brtson 'grus cher rgyas gyur nas kyang*// tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ hūm̐/ nor bu dmag dpon 'di nyid ni/ khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis// dgra bgegs tshar gcod gyur nas kyang*// tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/
